github.copilot.chat.commitMessageGenerat.text: Generate commit messages in Simplified Chinese based only on staged changes.
Use Conventional Commits format: <type>(optional scope): <short Chinese summary>.
Choose the type from feat, fix, docs, refactor, test, chore, build, ci, style, or perf.
Keep the subject concise and within 72 characters. Add a short Chinese body only when it materially improves clarity.
Do not exaggerate the scope of the change. For documentation-only changes such as AGENTS.md, README.md, or design docs, prefer docs.
Never include secrets, tokens, account information, private keys, or sensitive internal values.
